chunks: And it is narrated that a group of people on foot met the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and they complained to him about the hardship of walking.
So he said to them: “Seek assistance through brisk walking.”

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; indicates a reported transmission

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم advise people who found walking during travel difficult?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that some people complained to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم about the hardship of walking during travel. He instructed them to help themselves by adopting nasl, meaning a brisker or more efficient manner of walking.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2502 - It is narrated that a group of people who were walking met the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family), and they complained to him about the difficulty of walking.
Prophet (sw) said to them: "Seek assistance through walking briskly (nasl)."
